svg.aria-label: Superbee core mental model. How humans and agents use typed Markdown records, Kind definitions, and explicit relationships in one bundle.
svg.title: Superbee core mental model
svg.desc: Humans and agents work with the same ordinary Markdown records in one bundle. Convention documents declare shared fields and relationship vocabulary. A Roadmap contains a Roadmap Item, the item contains two Tasks, and the publishing Task depends on the explanation Task. A Context Note preserves the handoff for the next session.
